events.title: THE DEMO IS HERE!
events.summary: The Pizza Turbo demo is now available!This demo features approximately 10% of the game's total content. Version 1.0 launches on December 10, 2026, bringing the full experience, including lore, cutscenes, traps, unlockable content, and much more.I hope you enjoy the demo and have a blast delivering pizzas at full speed!

events.title: Can you read me okay?
events.summary: Pizza Turbo gets updated on the Steam page first, but I'm already working on the UI and subtitle translations for the following languages: Japanese Chinese Portuguese French German Italian Yeah, unfortunately you'll now be able to read everything the AI says with way more clarity... so I don't know if that's actually a good thing. 😅 The next demo will launch with all these languages already included!

events.title: What is this game, and why does it even exist?
events.summary: Well, I’m getting pretty close to releasing the DEMO, and in October, the 1.0 version of PIZZA TURBO.Yes, straight to 1.0. You read that right.And before you find yourself driving a pizza box at 150 km/h while a nuclear bomb is trying to ruin your entire day, I’d like to explain a little bit about what the hell you’re going to find inside the game. events.title: PIZZA TURBO - ROADMAP 2026
events.summary: We're currently in the Closed Playtest Era™, but the roadmap for this year is already cooking in the oven.There won't be an ultra-early-alpha-pre-pre-access-mega-beta thingy (I don't like that stuff), but there will be several playtest phases throughout the year. The playtest is limited to 200 brave pizza delivery professionals, and 140 spots are already gone. Don't wait until the pizza gets cold.

events.title: A small, EXCLUSIVE sneak peek from our friend ARC ARCADE RACING
events.summary: The folks at ARC Arcade Racing YT asked us for some gameplay footage, and how could I refuse?Here's a clip where they talk a bit about my game! Enlace a YouTube! More information coming very soon; we're close to a closed alpha (will I be at the next Next Fest?) Meanwhile, for more up-to-date information, you can follow me on X!
